question: Where can I find fast food restaurant inside 10 kilometers as I travel from Amazing Air, San Antonio, TX toward the Cross at Kerrville, Kerrville, TX?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Amazing Air%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Antonio%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), end_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cross at Kerrville%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Kerrville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sl.geometry, el.geometry)::geography, 10000) AS corridor_geometry FROM start_location sl, end_location el ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, travel_corridor tc WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, tc.corridor_geometry);
